actions.description: Premieres Aurelia: startup, common editing, safe peripheral attachment, Business Tools, eight-minute Abacus demonstration, then seven-minute BPI partner demonstration. DRI, MPI and the head of BPI speak in the seven-minute partners section. Academy and dealer configurations follow. Total 44 minutes before questions; see aurelia_1978_campaign.json.

outcomes.description: Platform includes AION software, peripherals, support, developer programs and Academy training.

Academy Fundamentals offers two days of hands-on learning before purchase; 50% tuition credit valid six months toward one Aurelia, redeemable at Academy or participating dealers reimbursed by Logix. Orders accepted at training; no purchase obligation. Locations, tuition and first class dates must be published once selected.
